import java.io.*;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class CF295C_ {

    static int[][][] dp1;
    static int[][][][] dp2;
    static long[][][] dp3;
    static int k;
    static int mod = 1000000007;
    static int F, H;
    static boolean[][][] vis;
    static long[][] comb;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        F = 0;
        H = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if(sc.nextInt() == 50)
                F++;
            else
                H++;
        }

        comb = new long[101][101];
        for (int i = 0; i < comb.length; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(comb[i], -1);
        }
        
        dp1 = new int[2][51][51];
        for (int i = 0; i < dp1.length; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dp1[i].length; j++) {
                Arrays.fill(dp1[i][j], -1);
            }
        }
        vis = new boolean[2][51][51];
        
        int min = solve(F, H, 0);
        if(min >= 1000000){
            System.out.println(-1);
            System.out.println(0);
            pw.flush();
            pw.close();
            return;
        }

        dp2 = new int[2][51][51][min+1];
        dp3 = new long[2][51][51][min+1];
        for (int i = 0; i < dp3.length; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dp3[i].length; j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < dp3[i][j].length; l++) {
                    Arrays.fill(dp3[i][j][l], -1);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(min);
        System.out.println(solve2(F, H, 0, min));

        pw.flush();
        pw.close();
    }

    static int solve(int fifty, int hundred, int side){
        if(fifty == 0 && hundred == 0 && side == 1)
            return 0;
        if(fifty == F && hundred == H && side == 0)
            return 0;
        if(dp1[side][fifty][hundred] != -1)
            return dp1[side][fifty][hundred];
        if(vis[side][fifty][hundred])
            return 1000000;
        vis[side][fifty][hundred] = true;
        int ans = 1000000;
        for (int ff = 0; ff <= fifty; ff++) {
            for (int hh = 0; hh <= hundred; hh++) {
                if(hh + ff == 0 || hh*100 + ff*50 > k)
                    continue;
                ans = Math.min(ans, 1 + solve(F - fifty + ff, H - hundred + hh, 1 ^ side));
            }
        }

        return dp1[side][fifty][hundred] = ans;
    }

    static long solve2(int fifty, int hundred, int side, int min){
        if(min < 0)
            return 0;
        if(fifty == 0 && hundred == 0 && side == 1) {
            if(min == 0)
                return 1;
            return 0;
        }
        if(fifty == F && hundred == H && side == 0) {
            if(min == 0)
                return 1;
            return 0;
        }
        if(min == 0)
            return 0;
        if(dp3[side][fifty][hundred][min] != -1)
            return dp3[side][fifty][hundred][min];
        
        long ans = 0;
        for (int ff = 0; ff <= fifty; ff++) {
            for (int hh = 0; hh <= hundred; hh++) {
                if(hh + ff == 0 || hh*100 + ff*50 > k)
                    continue;
                int nextFifty = F - fifty + ff;
                int nextHundred = H - hundred + hh;
                int nextSide = 1 ^ side;
                int needed = solve(nextFifty, nextHundred, nextSide);
                if(needed == min - 1) {
                    long ways = nCr(fifty, ff) * nCr(hundred, hh) % mod;
                    ans = (ans + ways * solve2(nextFifty, nextHundred, nextSide, min - 1)) % mod;
                }
            }
        }

        return dp3[side][fifty][hundred][min] = ans;
    }

    static long nCr(int n, int r) {
        if(r > n || r < 0) return 0;
        if(r == 0 || r == n) return 1;
        if(comb[n][r] != -1) return comb[n][r];
        return comb[n][r] = (nCr(n-1, r-1) + nCr(n-1, r)) % mod;
    }

    static class Scanner {
        StringTokenizer st; 
        BufferedReader br;
        public Scanner(InputStream s) { br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(s)); }
        public Scanner(String s) throws FileNotFoundException { br = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(new File(s))); }
        public String next() throws IOException { while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine()); return st.nextToken(); }
        public int nextInt() throws IOException { return Integer.parseInt(next()); }
        public long nextLong() throws IOException { return Long.parseLong(next()); }
        public String nextLine() throws IOException { return br.readLine(); }
        public boolean ready() throws IOException { return br.ready(); }
    }
}
